totalUsage.description: Total usage volume for the selected date range/host — validates the dashboard's summary export against ClickHouse directly.
totalUsage.totalTemplate: SELECT sum(usage_units) AS total FROM {{CH_DATABASE}}.daily_usage_summary WHERE host_id IN ({{HOST_ID}}) AND event_date BETWEEN {{DATE_FROM_UNIX}} AND {{DATE_TO_UNIX}}
totalUsage.perRowTemplate: SELECT country, sum(usage_units) AS total FROM {{CH_DATABASE}}.daily_usage_summary WHERE host_id IN ({{HOST_ID}}) AND event_date BETWEEN {{DATE_FROM_UNIX}} AND {{DATE_TO_UNIX}} GROUP BY country ORDER BY total DESC

widgets.name: Top Countries by Usage
widgets.chQueryTemplate: SELECT country AS dimension, sum(usage_units) AS total FROM {{CH_DATABASE}}.daily_usage_summary WHERE host_id IN ({{HOST_ID}}) AND event_date BETWEEN {{DATE_FROM_UNIX}} AND {{DATE_TO_UNIX}} GROUP BY country ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10
